$comment: Sandbox chapter for the deferred environment effects (#220) — NOT content: it lives outside content/chapters/, no campaign lists it, and nothing ships it. The same flooded landing as rift-skirmish (map rift_ferry), in a storm: mud that slows, briars that hold, a gust that throws, two captives (one the monsters can drag off), ground to hold and a small tear to close (closing it wins the fight), a storm that makes everyone easier to hit, a variant for when the storm is raging, a brute that shoves heroes into the briars and walks through them, a shade that always watches a captive, and a brute the rift pulls away once it is hurt. Played by packages/shared/src/encounter-environment.test.ts; judged by tools/content/encounter-environment.test.mjs.
title: The Storm Landing

objectives.label: Get Pip out of the storm
Get Moss out of the storm

scene_landing.narration: The storm has the landing now. Rain hisses on the water, and a small tear crackles near the top of the bank.

fight_storm.narration: A storm brute and a rift shade wade out of the rain. Pip and Moss are caught at the water's edge.

onVictory.narration: The storm drains away like bathwater.

variants.text: The beacon stone glows behind you.

onDefeat.narration: The wind knocks your feet from under you.

scene_calm.narration: The landing is quiet. Somewhere a frog starts up again, very pleased with itself.

variants.text: Moss shakes like a wet dog.

scene_swept.narration: You wake on the bank, soaked and sore. The storm has moved on.
